listing.name: Touhou 4: Lotus Land Story — Portable 64-bit
listing.summary: Play the native desktop preview using your own PC-98 game image and external font and sound resources.
listing.download_block_reason: Open the publisher’s preview release for the Windows ZIP. On Linux, follow the pinned source build.

steps.title: Prepare the Windows preview
steps.instruction: Extract the x64 preview into a writable folder and check the release SHA-256. Put your own th04.hdi, FREECG98.BMP and ym2608_adpcm_rom.bin beside th04-port64.exe. Compare your files with the tested input identities in the upstream guide. Play.bat starts the ordinary game outside Portcove.

steps.title: Register the Windows player
steps.instruction: Choose th04-port64.exe with its own folder as the working directory. Add these arguments as separate entries: --hdi th04.hdi --font-bmp FREECG98.BMP --save-dir save-normal --title --audio --pmd-driver pmd86 --opna-rom ym2608_adpcm_rom.bin. Save the launch details and choose Play.

steps.title: Build a Linux x86-64 copy
steps.instruction: Follow the pinned Portable 64-bit Linux build with CMake, a C++17 compiler and SDL2 development files. Start the built th04-port64 from your prepared folder and set the input paths and save directory as shown in the upstream Linux command.

warnings: The upstream preview offers an assisted mode with its own save directory. Use the ordinary player for regular play and keep both profiles separately.

references.title: Keep scores and settings
references.instruction: Keep MIKO.CFG and GENSOU.SCR together under your effective save directory. The bundled launchers use save-normal and save-no-life-loss. A direct run without --save-dir uses %LOCALAPPDATA%/TH04 on Windows or $XDG_DATA_HOME/th04 on Linux, usually ~/.local/share/th04. Close the game before replacing its player.
